verdict.rationale: Ramp's Developer API is clearly versioned: endpoints sit under /developer/v1/ and the canonical OpenAPI spec is titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1). No deprecation policy, sunset timeline or change-notice process is documented anywhere in the pack. The only lifecycle language is a caveat that some banking endpoints "may receive breaking changes," which is not a policy. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, a changelog or advance-notice commitment for breaking changes, and any guidance on version migration or support windows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: a parseable OpenAPI document titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) with 174 documented paths
